PartnerTREM + AdminTREM

Agency operations.
Platform-wide oversight.

From people and inventory to payments and delivery: the operational detail behind every traveller experience.

01Agency operations+

Know what needs attention.

Agency admins can see the movement from enquiry to delivery instead of tracking disconnected spreadsheets.

  • Incoming customer requirements waiting for action
  • Draft, sent and revised commercial proposals
  • Confirmed bookings that still need delivery actions
  • Marketplace-ready travel inventory
02People & access+

Manage the people responsible for every journey.

Invite agents, manage their status and keep workspace ownership clear.

  • Agency profile and workspace
  • Team invitations and account status
  • Role-based product access
  • Assigned operational responsibility
03Tour inventory+

Create once. Manage departures. Publish when ready.

Approved tours can participate in the TravelsTREM marketplace where the agency is enrolled.

  • Overview and commercial information
  • Day-wise itinerary
  • Hotels and inclusions
  • Departures and capacity
  • Eligible inventory distributed through Trevista
04Enquiries & CRM+

Keep the requirement, conversation and next action together.

Requirements, assigned agent, tour reference, quote activity and booking status remain connected.

  • Customer requirements and travel preferences
  • Assigned agent and enquiry ownership
  • Quote activity and follow-up
  • Connected booking status
05Quotes & pricing+

Build options around the traveller.

Pricing logic stays centrally governed instead of being duplicated in every product flow.

  • Package variants and traveller customisations
  • Itemised commercial review
  • Draft, send, review and revise
  • Acceptance carried forward to payment
06Journey fulfilment+

A booking is not finished when payment succeeds.

Documents, payment progress and status stay visible from the customer’s dashboard.

  • Accepted quote and advance payment
  • Tickets, passes and hotel vouchers
  • Balance collection and final settlement
  • Delivery status until journey completion
07Payments & records+

Track collections without losing booking context.

Operational records connect booking value, payments, outstanding balances and agency-level reporting.

  • Final agreed customer amount
  • Advance payments and collected amounts
  • Remaining settlement and payment schedule
  • Booking-to-payment reporting
08AdminTREM oversight+

Central platform governance above agency operations.

PartnerTREM manages the agency journey. AdminTREM gives the platform owner oversight across the ecosystem.

  • Partner and internal team management
  • Access and configuration
  • Platform approvals
  • Cross-product reporting
